texts.preamble: D. Srinivasa Rao, Venkatapuram V And M, ... vs The State Of A.P., Hyderabad, And Anr. on 5 July, 2024 The Honourable Sri Justice K.Surender Criminal Revision Case No.1599 Of 2009 Order:
texts.facts: Aggrieved by the same, present revision is filed. The revision petitioner who was running Kirana store was prosecuted by the Food Inspector on the ground that he was selling adulterated oil. On 07.09.2001, PW1 who is the Food Inspector visited the general stores and found five packs of oil in the premises. The said oil was packed by Rama Krishna Sai Traders of Chilakaluripeta. The said oil was kept for sale and human consumption. Accordingly, he purchased the oil from the shop and from one sealed cover he had cut open and taken samples. The said sampling was done in the shop and thereafter it was sent for analysis. It was found by the lab that the sample does not conform to Bellier's test (Turbidity temperature-Acetic Acid method) contains Palmolin oil. For the said reason of the groundnut oil containing Palmolin oil, according to the Food Inspector, it was adulterated and accordingly complaint was filed. 4. Learned Trial Judge having taken cognizance of the offence under Section 16(1)(a)(ii), 7(i) and (v) and 2(ia)(m)(b) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, conducted trial. 5. Prosecution examined PWs.1 to 3 and marked Exs.P1 to P27. Considering the evidence, the trial Court found that the accused was selling adulterated oil, accordingly, convicted the revision petitioner/accused. The said conviction was questioned in appeal before the Sessions Court. Further, even according to the complaint, the oil was packed and manufactured by Ramakrishna Sai Traders of Chilakaluripeta. The said firm was also not prosecuted.
texts.arguments: 6. Learned Legal Aid Counsel appearing for the revision petitioner would submit that the process of sampling was incorrect.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 6. Learned Legal Aid Counsel appearing for the revision petitioner would submit that the process of sampling was incorrect.
